_comment: RSNA/STR Pulmonary Embolism Detection Challenge (2020). CT Pulmonary Angiography (CTPA) dataset from 5 international institutions, 7279 studies × one series each, stored as per-slice DICOMs under train/<StudyInstanceUID>/<SeriesInstanceUID>/<SOPInstanceUID>.dcm. Integrated as 3D per-volume classification: image_path points at the series directory and MONAI's ITKReader assembles the 3D volume on the fly. train.csv is per-slice in the release but 13 of 14 labels are identical across all slices of a study; we collapse to one row per study and drop the lone slice-level label (pe_present_on_image).

primary_csv._comment: train.csv — one row per SOPInstanceUID. Sits one level above base_image_dir (auto-discovered).

patient_id._comment: No distinct patient column. StudyInstanceUID is used as the patient key (one study per patient in this release — additional studies per patient were excluded during curation).

image_path._comment: DICOM series DIRECTORY (not a single file). MONAI's ITKReader loads all .dcm files in the directory and assembles a 3D volume. Relative to base_image_dir (which points at train/).

labels._comment: 13 study-level labels (already snake_case and 0/1 one-hot in train.csv). The 14th CSV column, pe_present_on_image, is slice-level and is dropped when collapsing per-slice rows to per-study rows; study-level PE presence is already covered by the location flags (leftsided_pe / rightsided_pe / central_pe).

separate_csv._comment: Labels are in the primary CSV.

uncertain_handling._comment: Labels are final consensus 0/1 — no NaN or -1 values in the release.

view_position._comment: Not applicable — all studies are axial CTPA.

masks._comment: No segmentation masks. pe_present_on_image is a slice-level classification flag — not a pixel mask — and is discarded at volume granularity.

bboxes._comment: No bounding boxes (annotators used only study/image-level labels per the paper).

extra_init_params._comment: hu_window tuple (default (-1000, 1000)) is accepted by the dataset constructor; no dataset-specific params beyond that and the standard csv_path / base_image_dir.

custom_preprocessing: Custom harmonize() collapses per-slice CSV rows to one row per StudyInstanceUID (drop_duplicates) and drops pe_present_on_image. image_path is a DICOM series directory rather than a single file, so the harmonizer and dataset both override verify_images to use os.path.isdir. Image loading uses the standard RadiologyTransform3D pipeline: ITKReader series load → HU window (-1000, 1000) → 0.5/99.5 percentile scaling to [-1, 1] → resize/pad to 112³.
